ndvi.limitation: Cloud-masked satellite observation; off-swath and cloudy pixels rendered fully transparent.

ndmi.color_scale: Orange (-0.3, moisture stress) -> Cyan (moderate) -> Blue (high moisture 0.5)
ndmi.limitation: Reflects canopy water content and open water surfaces on date of overpass.

bsi.color_scale: Green (-0.3, vegetated/non-bare) -> Cream (intermediate) -> Dark Amber (0.3, exposed soil)
bsi.limitation: Identifies bare soil and fallow fields; sensitivity depends on surface soil moisture and crop residue.

slope.color_scale: Cream (0-2 deg, flat alluvial plains) -> Amber (2-5 deg) -> Crimson (>10 deg, embankments)
slope.limitation: Derived from 30m radar elevation model; micro-topography below 30m resolution is smoothed.
